label: All relevant actual own-being causes are the selected p
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. For each participant x and distinct actual OwnBeing c causing x in the esse respect, c is numerically identical with the selected p. Unrelated own-being bearers are outside this quantifier. This is the conclusion to be derived from an identity dictionary, at-most-one and a selected witness, not a definition making selection true.
